tool: FluidAudio v0.9.1 fluidaudiocli transcribe --model-version v2 (parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2 Core ML), upstream CLI built from source with Swift 6.3.3 in Swift 5 language mode; whole files, no app VAD
data: Same clips and normalization as whisper-models.json; WER recomputed with one script for every model (lowercase, punctuation stripped, hyphens as spaces).

muted_mic_false_words.note: seven synthetic non-speech tracks, 3 minutes each

speed.note: includes warm Core ML load; Whisper large-v3 real-time factor was 0.12-0.18

limits: Public audio only; 5 AMI tracks and 4 LibriSpeech joins, so treat the ranking as a strong direction, not a precise figure. Not yet run on the owner's recordings.

in_app_pipeline.what: parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2 installed through the app's checksummed installer and run through the app's own speech-aligned chunking and native helper (`parakeet benchmark run`)
in_app_pipeline.note: The app's chunking improved TDT on AMI from 18.44% (whole files) to 16.42%; Whisper large-v3 scored 19.52%. Same public clips and scoring script as above.
